request: Make the platform release packages complete so start.command can start without manually downloading and copying the Docker image; update docs and publish the release.
root_cause: The RC7 launcher ZIP contained .aide-image but no Docker archive. start.command therefore selected the bundle path and exited with a missing archive error. The image existed only as a separate GitHub Release asset and README required manual copy.
changes: macOS and Ubuntu Bash launchers automatically download the matching image and SHA256SUMS when missing, verify SHA256 and imported image ID, then start without build or pull.
Windows PowerShell launcher performs the same download, checksum, and image ID validation.
Checksum download can be retried independently if an image download already completed.
Release package README and offline install docs explain first-start network use and offline pre-seeding.
Release image packaging always re-exports the image matching the current Docker image ID rather than reusing a stale same-name archive.
Docker release test stage installs the pinned Office Python dependencies so Office integration tests run instead of failing from an incomplete test environment.

evidence: scripts/docker-release.sh completed: full Go test suite passed, go vet and build passed, and temporary container healthz passed.
bash -n passed for aide, Docker release, package-release-assets, and publish-release-assets scripts; git diff --check passed.
The linux/arm64 image archive passed gzip -t; the macOS, Windows ARM64, and Ubuntu ARM64 ZIPs passed unzip -t; all six local SHA256SUMS entries passed.
GitHub Release API reports all six assets uploaded. Downloaded remote SHA256SUMS compared byte-for-byte equal to the local manifest.
The image in launcher .aide-image markers matches the linux/arm64 image archive and published image ID sha256:7e4bcf76debbb3c85fae94b4540b23487f8eeb1f9822ebb1728988b6c575de43.
not_run: Windows and Ubuntu physical host launcher execution.
First launch through a fresh user's Docker installation and automatic download path.

rollback: Use the previous RC7 launcher and matching RC7 image. Keep existing Docker volumes; do not remove user workspace or data volumes.
